question: How much does it cost to buy all the grande-sized products marked with '*' in the espresso creations?

steps.description: Locate the espresso creations section and identify all products marked with an asterisk (*)
Find the Caramel Macchiato item in espresso creations and read its grande size price
Find the Caffe Latte item in espresso creations and read its grande size price
Find the Cappuccino item in espresso creations and read its grande size price
Find the Caffe Mocha item in espresso creations and read its grande size price
Sum the grande prices from steps 2, 3, 4, and 5 to get the total cost
